context: Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan task P5.3 (R-7).
description:
## Problem
The user's local result file redacts receipt statements and reasons (`exporter.py:105` defaults `anonymize=True`), and the console prints no verification summary.

## Change (per gate D-3)
- Apply the decided local-file anonymization default or flag.
- After every run, print status, counts by verdict, the top 3 reasons, and the dropped intents.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Publish and public export stay fully anonymized.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
